start.message:
Hello! I am AlphaPack, a Telegram group management bot.

Add me to a group and give me admin rights to get started.

welcome.default_message:
Welcome to the group, {name}! 👋
Please read the group rules before chatting.
welcome.goodbye_message: Goodbye, {name}. We hope to see you again!

moderation.warn_threshold_reached: 🚫 {name} has reached the warn threshold and has been {action}.
moderation.no_reply: ❌ Reply to a user message to use this command.

errors.generic: ❌ An error occurred. Please try again.
errors.permission_denied: ❌ You do not have permission to use this command.
errors.dm_blocked: ℹ️ Could not send a DM to the user — they may have blocked the bot.
